name: C.D. Christmas Days ~Circus Disc Christmas Days~
original_name: C.D. Christmas Days ～サーカスディスク クリスマスデイズ～
source:
A fan disc for various Circus games.

In the first story Junichi and Kotori from "Da Capo" are coming out of the crisis, in which their relationships were entered. A romantic story with some comedy elements.
In the second story Tsumire from "AR ~ Wasurerareta Natsu ~" cohabits with the protagonist trying to learn how to become a good wife. Should I mention that her training is not limited by laundry washing and cooking?
The third story tells us about the love relationships of Sae and Mutsumi. We can also see them working part-time. It's all about the characters from "Saishuu Shiken Kujira".
The fourth story tells us about the time when Sena from "Sukumizu 2" came to see the protagonist before the swimming competition, but she couldn't hold back her erotic desires.
The last story is a spin-off off the "Da Capo II" vn, in which Yoshiyuki, Yume and Otome have tasted the forbidden fruit, in all senses of the phrase.
translation:
这是Circus旗下多部游戏的粉丝光盘。

第一个故事讲述了《Da Capo》中纯一与小鸟走出感情危机的经过，是一段带有喜剧元素的浪漫故事。
第二个故事讲述了《AR～被遗忘的夏天～》中摘入与主人公同居，努力学习如何成为一名好妻子的故事。需要说明的是，她的修行可不仅限于洗衣做饭。
第三个故事围绕小枝和睦美的恋爱关系展开，我们还能看到她们打工的日常。角色均出自《最终试炼Kujira》。
第四个故事讲述了《Sukumizu 2》中濑名在游泳比赛前来找主人公，却无法抑制自己的情欲的故事。
最后一个故事是《Da Capo II》的衍生篇，义之、梦和乙女品尝了禁果——无论是字面意义上还是比喻意义上。
